context.body: Selected for the reader trail because “Kingship, truth, and the choice of Barabbas” preserves a distinct parallel witness source unit within sentencing.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The accusers remain outside the Praetorium, Pilate questions Jesus about kingship and truth, reports no basis for a charge, and offers a release.
observations.label: Kingship, truth, and the choice of Barabbas: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps jesus, pilate, accusers visible within its Crucifixion evidence.
observations.label: Kingship, truth, and the choice of Barabbas: action, promise, or consequence

payload.posture: Read John 18:28–40 as its own sentencing and mockery crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.
payload.title: Kingship, truth, and the choice of Barabbas
